name: jev-status
description: Asks TypeSafe Jev whether each turn left the task done, needaction or failed (and Claude when Jev is unsure), and shows the verdict above the prompt

api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
api_key.description: From https://console.typesafe.ai/keys. Leave empty to use $TYPESAFE_API_KEY or ~/.config/typesafe/api_key.

toast.title: Toast each verdict
toast.description: Also show each verdict as a toast

claude_below.title: Ask Claude below (% Jev confidence)
claude_below.description: When Jev's confidence is under this percentage, ask Claude for a second opinion and show Claude's answer. 0 never asks.

claude_view.title: Claude's view
claude_view.description: summary: Claude reads what Jev read (prompt, final message, tool errors). conversation: Claude reads the whole session; this always uses the session's own model.

review_model.title: Claude review model
review_model.description: Model for Claude's review in the summary view: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id.

claude_on_jev_failure.title: Ask Claude when Jev can't answer
claude_on_jev_failure.description: With no TypeSafe key or a Jev error, ask Claude instead of showing the error
